Care with compassion, precision and comfort

Questions patients ask first

Do I need to pay to book?

No. Booking is free. You pay at the clinic after your consultation, or nothing for treatment your scheme covers.

Which schemes do you accept?

CGHS, RGHS and ECHS for covered treatment, and CAPF and Air India panels. Send us your card type on WhatsApp to check before you visit.

What should I bring?

Your scheme card and referral if you have one, any old X-rays or dental reports, and a list of medicines you take.

What are your timings?

Ramganj is open Monday to Saturday, 9:30 am to 7 pm, and Sunday 10 am to 1 pm. Chandravardai Nagar is open Monday to Saturday, 5 pm to 8 pm.

Do you treat children?

Yes. We see children from about three years old for check-ups, fillings and advice on brushing.

Can I pay in instalments?

EMI is available for implants and larger treatment plans. Ask at the front desk for the current options.

You deserve the best care. Book today.

Booking is free. We confirm your slot on WhatsApp within 30 minutes during clinic hours.
